# Security Policy

Security fixes are considered for the latest release and the current `master` branch.

Report vulnerabilities through
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue.

Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps, and known mitigations. Remove credentials,
phone numbers, Call-IDs, raw SIP messages, packet captures, and identifiable network details.

Reports are handled on a best-effort basis. No response or fix time is guaranteed. Keep the report
private until disclosure is coordinated with the maintainer.

For non-security bugs, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/aibudaevv/sip-exporter/issues).
Operational hardening is documented in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
